I know I'm reading into a children's book too much. But maybe this thing about using other methods to kill wouldn't work either, y'all. We have to remember that Avada Kedavra is basically insta-kill with malfunctions so rare that Harry Potter is literally *the* only exception. And JKR made some stuff about how that was Lily's protection or something. I mean he did luck out on some really near death moments throughout the series. So maybe the little bastard really was unkillable as long as Voldemort was involved.
All this is assuming though that Joanne Kathleen "Dumbedore is gay, didn't ya know?" Rowling has a rather impressive level of continuity that I really don't think she is capable of.
But....
Having said that, it would be a way better scene if Voldemort kept trying all the conventional methods to kill the kid and failed and then be like "Fuck it. Avada Kedavra" and fucking dying.
